note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes User.Read -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser); only to read the labadmin address

./src/Invoke-PurviewCompliance.ps1 -PolicyFile ./src/compliance.lab.json -Audit -SaveInventory ./src/inventory.lab.json   # what already exists (default labels or a default Teams DLP policy)? rename ours in the lab copy if names clash

steps: Purview portal > Information Protection > Sensitivity labels: Contoso-Public, Contoso-General, Contoso-Confidential
Information Protection > Label policies: 'Contoso labels - pilot'
Data loss prevention > Policies: both policies, status 'In simulation with notifications'
Data lifecycle management > Retention labels: 'Contoso Contract - 7 years'

screens.name: label
steps: (At least 24 h after the 'plan' screen, so the label policy has reached Alex)
OneDrive > New > Word document, name it 'Q4 supplier contract'
Home > Sensitivity: show Public, General, Confidential and their tooltips
Choose Confidential: the red centered header 'CONFIDENTIAL - Contoso internal' appears
If the Sensitivity button is missing, say why (labels for SharePoint/OneDrive not turned on, or the policy has not arrived); do not fake it
mask: Alex e-mail beyond the lab alias

screens.name: dlp-tip
steps: New mail > To: partner@example.com (reserved domain, nothing is ever sent), subject 'Customer list'
Paste the 12 generated lines (from the terminal part) into the body
Wait for the policy tip bar with 'Blocked: 10 or more card numbers can't leave Contoso...'
Discard the draft, NEVER press Send

screens.name: simulation
screens.account: alex.demo for the document, labadmin for the portal
steps: (Off camera, a day earlier, as alex.demo: OneDrive > New > Word document 'Customer list', paste the same 12 lines, close it, do NOT share it)
Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies > 'Contoso - Card numbers' > View simulation
Simulation overview shows the matched item; Items for review lists 'Customer list.docx'
Promote the policy in the terminal (see also[]); then refresh the policy page
mask: names other than the fictional lab users

teardown: foreach ($p in 'Contoso - Card numbers', 'Contoso - Confidential label') { Get-DlpComplianceRule -Policy $p | Remove-DlpComplianceRule -Confirm:$false; Remove-DlpCompliancePolicy -Identity $p -Confirm:$false }

Get-RetentionComplianceRule -Policy 'Contoso retention labels' | Remove-RetentionComplianceRule -Confirm:$false; Remove-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Identity 'Contoso retention labels' -Confirm:$false; Remove-ComplianceTag -Identity 'Contoso Contract - 7 years' -Confirm:$false
Remove-LabelPolicy -Identity 'Contoso labels - pilot' -Confirm:$false; foreach ($l in 'Contoso-Public', 'Contoso-General', 'Contoso-Confidential') { Remove-Label -Identity $l -Confirm:$false }
# by hand: delete 'Q4 supplier contract' and 'Customer list' from Alex's OneDrive and its recycle bin; discard any Outlook draft
needs: role:Compliance Administrator (labadmin); Global Administrator once to turn labels on for SharePoint/OneDrive
wait:24h between screen plan and screens label/dlp-tip/simulation (labels and policies need time to reach apps)
manual:turn on sensitivity labels for Office files in SharePoint and OneDrive (Purview banner, Turn on now)
manual:as alex.demo create Customer list.docx the day before the simulation screen
